meta.name: BKW · q ≍ n², width ≍ n · 8n samples
meta.regime: Uniform-secret LWE, prime q=Θ(n²), discrete-Gaussian width s=Θ(n); m=(8+o(1))n original samples
meta.rules: Use q=Θ(n²), Gaussian width s=Θ(n), and exactly the displayed asymptotic sample budget. Constant Gaussian normalizations do not change these exponents. These are interior parameters c_q=2,c_s=1; they are not the Regev q≈n²,width≈n^{3/2}/polylog(n) regime.
